item.title: 19½ Things You Didn't Know About Accessibility in HTML and CSS
'CSS Scroll-Triggered Animations Are Here, And I Completely Missed Them'
item.description: Triggered animations are CSS animations that respond to a trigger being either active or inactive. We can specify animation actions and use it, for example, to play, pause or reverse animations based on if the trigger is active or not. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Responsive iframes in Chrome 154
item.description: Chrome 154 adds support for responsively-sized iframes, letting an iframe size itself based on the intrinsic size of its embedded document. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: A Decent Custom Checkbox Pattern for Until ::checkmark is Ready
item.description: We're a while off from being able to leverage ::checkmark with checkbox styling, but here's a decent way to get the styling control you want, while preserving the useful parts of the native input element. (1 source: frontendfocus)
